verdict.rationale: pnpm's content-addressable store caches previously-downloaded package tarballs/files so re-installs pull from local cache rather than the network (pnpm-docs-15/28/38), and --offline (pnpm-docs-10) lets installs use only the local store. But there is no documentation addressing the specific case of prebuilt native binary packages avoiding source compilation (e.g. node-gyp/prebuild-install behavior) — missing for 10: explicit handling of native/binary package prebuilds, evidence that compilation steps are skipped when a cached binary exists, and independent confirmation of this specific caching path.
